### workspace list --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace list [options]

List currently active (launched) projects.
Plain list reads the state file and does not check that each project is still
running; add --liveness to check each project's tmux session.

Options:
        --all                        List all available projects (not just active ones)
        --json                       Output as JSON
        --json-envelope              Output as JSON in the standard envelope (implies --json)
        --show-urls                  Include the git origin URL alongside each project name
        --liveness                   Mark each active project alive, dead, or unknown from its tmux session

Examples:
  workspace list    # list active (launched) projects
  workspace list --all    # list all available projects
  workspace list --show-urls    # each active project with its git origin URL
  workspace list --json    # active projects as JSON
  workspace list --json-envelope    # {"schema_version":1,"ok":true,"workspaces":[...],"warnings":[]}
  workspace list --liveness    # each active project marked [alive], [dead], or [unknown]
  workspace list --liveness --json    # [{"name":"my-notes","alive":true,"window_alive":true},...]
  workspace list --all --json --show-urls    # all projects with directories and URLs as JSON
--- stderr
--- end
